newsitem.title: CHINA: China Huaxia Bank profits 410 mln yuan in 96 - paper.
newsitem.headline: China Huaxia Bank profits 410 mln yuan in 96 - paper.

text.p: China's Huaxia Bank made total profits of 410 million yuan ($49.4 million) in 1996, the Financial News said on Wednesday.

The newspaper did not say whether the profit figures were pre- or post-tax, but said Huaxia's foreign and local currency deposits were worth 16.1 billion yuan at the end of the year, while loans extended were worth 9.7 billion yuan.

Huaxia, a shareholding bank that was split off from China's giant Capital Iron and Steel Corp two years ago, made pre-tax profits of 190 million yuan in 1995, up 147 percent compared with the year before, bank officials have said.

A recent meeting of Huaxia branch managers had stressed the need to boost financial controls, cut risk in banking operations, strengthen internal accounting and ensure loans procedures were checked by legally-qualified staff, Financial News said.
It gave no further details of the bank's 1996 performance.
